Temperature Covariate Preparation for Tuolumne

Liz Stebbins

2024-07-10

Pull in temperature data for Tuolumne

Historical temperatures were pulled for the Tuolumne from the USGS gage 11290000 and are processed here to be used in the Tuolumne VA stock-recruit analyses.

Temperature data were pulled and QC’d in /historical-flow-data/Tuolumne/pull_tuolune_gage_data.R

Create temperature covariates from historical flows
